name: Bay Area Entrepreneur Center
description: Business coaching, workshops, and tools for aspiring and current entrepreneurs, with free opportunities for Skyline College students
fullDescription: The Bay Area Entrepreneur Center (BAEC) of Skyline College is a business accelerator and resource center in downtown San Bruno that helps students and community entrepreneurs turn skills and passions into businesses.
whatTheyOffer:
- Consultations and individual coaching to start or grow a business
- Workshops and easy-to-use business tools and guides
- Guidance on basic business licenses and permits
- Maker and beauty/barbering business programs
- Pop-up market opportunities (free booths for Skyline students)
- Student fellowship program supporting local businesses and nonprofits
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the Bay Area Entrepreneur Center website
2. Choose a program that fits your business
3. Sign up for a consultation
4. Attend workshops and coaching sessions
5. Access ongoing support as your business grows
address: 458 San Mateo Ave, San Bruno, CA 94066
keywords: Bay Area Entrepreneur Center, BAEC, Skyline College, small business, startup, entrepreneur, business consulting, workshops, networking, San Bruno
